visualCharacteristics: Grid of white rounded product cards with shadow (1 / 2 / 3 / 4 columns at 0 / 768 / 1024 / 1440px): product image, uppercase brand, title, subtitle, price, green/red stock dot and a blue Details pill; the whole card links to the product page and lifts on hover. An optional header row above the grid.
contentPattern:
One row per product, cells classified by content: picture cell = image; heading cell = optional

brand

, heading with the link to the product page, optional subtitle paragraph; other cell = price paragraph and stock paragraph ( = not available). A row with only text (e.g. an h2) is the list header. Generated by the json2html template templates/randapparatuur/overview.html from the products sheet.
usage: Product overview of the Ziggo randapparatuur webshop, rendered from all rows of the products sheet via json2html (BYOM overlay).
reuseGuidance: Use for any product grid that links to product-detail pages; filter or reorder products in the sheet, not in the block.
